C1012.title: Gold Farming Studio Convicted for Copyright Infringement; CrossFire Assists Police in Full-Chain Anti-Cheat Crackdown
C1012.summary: Between June 2022 and January 2023, Li A used game cheats in CrossFire to automatically farm maps, illegally obtaining in-game resources such as CF Points, and profited by purchasing equipment for resale.
